text:
```yaml
name: Publish Extension to Marketplace
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/extension-publish-marketplace.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'dist/**'
      - '!**.md'
      - '!**.txt'
      - '!**.log'
      - '!**.yml'
      - '!**.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish-extension:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .

      - name: Build Extension
        run: |
          npm run build

      - name: Publish to Visual Studio Marketplace
        uses: HikariAssistant/vscode-marketplace-publish@v1
        with:
          extension-file: './dist/*.vsix'
          pat: ${{ secrets.VSCE_PAT }}
          marketplace: 'visualstudio'
          publish: true
          version: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Publish to Open VSX Registry
        uses: HikariAssistant/vscode-open-vsx-publish@v1
        with:
          extension-file: './dist/*.vsix'
          pat: ${{ secrets.OPEN_VSX_PAT }}
          publish: true
          version: ${{ github.sha }}
```
